Title: XMLInsertAfter (
Description:
The function modifies the XML document of the given source XML tree entity by adding new siblings to
the node specified by the entity. Siblings will be added right after the node.
The source entity should be XML tree entity, not "persistent XML" entity.
The value of source should be a node entity; source can not be an attribute entity or a root entity.
